newsitem.title: USA: Bear Stearns sells fiduciary services.
newsitem.headline: Bear Stearns sells fiduciary services.

text.p: The Bear Stearns Companies Inc said on Wednesday that it sold its wholly owned subsidiary, Bear Stearns Fiduciary Services Inc to the management of that concern.
The former subsidiary, now known as Independent Fiduciary Services Inc, is a specialized pension fund investment consulting firm with offices in Washington, D.C. and New York.
Bear Stearns will continue to work with Independent Fiduciary Services on a joint venture basis.
Francis Lilly is chairman and president of Independent Fiduciary Services.
